new: Automatic quality: when frames run late, every headset now drops from 90 to 72 Hz first, before it lowers foveation or resolution (until now only a Quest 3S did). Coming back up, 90 Hz returns last.
The Debug tab's refresh rate step can still be set to last or never by hand; a setting made there before wins.
test: On the Quest 3, in a heavy story or a big studio scene: the Debug tab's Frame rate line should say 72 Hz once it struggles, with foveation and resolution still untouched (Automatic quality: Level 0).
Leave the heavy scene for a light one: after a while it should go back to 90 Hz.
untested: On a real headset: how often it now drops to 72 Hz, whether 72 Hz feels comfortable, and how quickly it comes back to 90 Hz. Checked only with a pretend headset in a desktop browser.
